note: Overview of sector S04_cafes (Rue des Saveurs), repainted Oct 22 2026 with the building exteriors as reference so the square shows the same buildings: the Café de la Place on the left (big coffee cup on the roof, green shopfront, green-and-white striped awning, cup-handle sign board, pastry arch door, sugar-cube windows, bistro tables), the Restaurant Le Bon Goût on the right (toque chimney, fork-and-knife gable over the sign board, round plate-shaped doorway with a ribbon bow, copper-pan kitchen window and wooden side door, round barrel cellar door), and the verb lane through the stone arch topped by a rolling pin in the centre (route start = Place du Grand-Festin, the route returns here from Allée des Cuisiniers).
